name: Safe Actions
description: Review and govern typed tool plans before they can touch the world. Safe Actions shows the exact sequence, parallel branches, conditions, effects, and resources a verified agent proposed; explains every deterministic policy finding and counterexample; lets an authorized reviewer approve or deny plans that require judgment; and preserves hash-bound execution receipts without exposing raw secrets. It is the control surface for Core's generic fail-closed verified-plan gate: approval resumes the persisted plan, while the Companion itself never invokes a tool or executes an action.
tagline: Prove the plan, review the risk, keep the receipt

permission_levels.label: Can manage
permission_levels.description: Read execution evidence, create and change policies and contracts, approve or deny plans awaiting review, and download receipts. Approving a plan resumes its persisted Core execution.

chat_widget_templates.description: Open the verified plan review queue in the Safe Actions Companion.
